raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Provider Engagement Professional 2 develops and grows positive, long-term relationships with physicians, providers, and healthcare systems. These relationships are established in order to support and improve financial and quality performance within the contracted working relationship with the health plan. The Provider Engagement Professional 2 work assignments are varied and frequently require interpretation and independent determination of the appropriate courses of action.

Humana Healthy Horizons in Oklahoma is seeking a Provider Engagement Professional who develops and grows positive, long-term relationships with physicians, providers and healthcare systems in order to support and improve financial and quality performance within the contracted working relationship with the health plan. The Provider Engagement Professional work assignments are varied and frequently require interpretation and independent determination of the appropriate courses of action.

The Provider Relations Representative is responsible for day-to-day front line relationship management for network providers in Humana’s Healthy Horizons in Oklahoma’s Medicaid Plan, including provider onboarding, training, education, responding to provider inquiries, and resolving issues or complaints. This role will support physical and behavioral health providers in their designated region and must be based in Oklahoma. The role will require critical thinking/problem solving skills, understanding of health plan operations, and strong interpersonal skills.

Key Role Objectives

  • Serve as primary relationship manager with physical and behavioral health providers to ensure positive provider experience with Humana Healthy Horizons and promote network retention

  • Meet regularly, both in person and virtually, with assigned providers to conduct trainings and education, including required annual trainings, ensure understanding of Humana policies and procedures, explain Humana systems, etc.

  • Support new assigned providers with onboarding, including orientation session(s)

  • Respond to assigned provider questions or inquires, and if necessary, ensure prompt resolution to provider issues with appropriate enterprise business teams, including those associated with claims payment, prior authorizations, and referrals, as well as appropriate education about participation in Humana’s Oklahoma Medicaid plan

  • Convene Service Operating Committee meetings with providers, including organizing agendas, materials, and other team members (clinical, provider engagement), to discuss key operational, clinical, and quality related topics

  • Communicate updates on Humana’s policies and procedures and Oklahoma’s SoonerSelect programmatic updates

  • Coordinate regional provider townhalls and/or trainings

  • Work with internal resources and systems (e.g., claims, reimbursement, provider enrollment) to provide the Perfect Experience in all provider interactions with Humana’s Oklahoma Medicaid plan

  • Ensure compliance with Oklahoma’s managed care contractual requirements for provider relations, such as claims dispute resolution within specified timeframes

.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of health care or managed care experience working with providers (e.g., provider relations, claims education)

  • Understanding of claims systems, adjudication, submission processes, coding, and/or dispute resolution

  • Must reside in Oklahoma

  • Willing and able to travel frequently to providers and Humana locations (daily travel up to 50% of the time)

​

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • Experience with Oklahoma Medicaid

  • Experience working with behavioral health providers, facilities and/or FQHCs is strongly desired

  • Understanding of provider contracts and credentialing, including contract language and reimbursement

Additional Information

This role is considered a hybrid role that will have you working from your remote office while you are not traveling to providers and you must live in the State of Oklahoma to be considered for this opportunity.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$59,300 - $80,900 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. We work hard, care deeply and reach further to help people uncover their own power to be healthy. We inspire hope. We learn, grow, and achieve more – in our careers and in our communities.

Job Description Summary:

The Sr IT Engineer (VDI) will work to design, deploy, and maintain our virtual desktop infrastructure. You’ll own the health and performance of our virtual desktop and app publishing environment, working closely with infrastructure and security teams to deliver a fast, reliable, and secure remote workspace experience for end users.

Responsibilities And Duties:

40% - Operations
Works with internal customers and 3rd party vendors to communicate, coordinate, manage expectations, approve, and assist with operational processes such as crisis management, support escalation, change management, release management, capacity management, and other ITIL processes

20% - Technology Strategy

Assists and sometimes leads the development of technology strategy and roadmap within a given area of specialty including design, documentation, communication, and implementation of new or existing standards for infrastructure technologies while remaining current on industry trends
10% - Research and Analysis
Analyzes, plans, justifies, schedules, and coordinates the implementation and maintenance of the specialty area’s administrative, operational, and financial initiatives including TCO, optimization, and efficiency
25% - Supplier Management
Works with suppliers and, when needed, vendors to produce outcomes consistent with organizational strategy. Overseas reporting metrics, dashboards, and status reporting to meet expectations for quality and performance for discretionary, support and maintenance work.
5% - Financial Management - Plans, monitors and controls operating and capital budget for assigned areas of responsibilities.


As a High Reliability Organization (HRO), responsibilities require focus on safety, quality and efficiency in performing job duties.

The job profile provides an overview of responsibilities and duties and is not intended to be an exhaustive list and is subject to change at any time

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree (Required)

Additional Job Description:

  • Degree; Field of Study: Business Administration, Computer/Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or Related Field
  • Years of Experience: 8 years technical engineering experience

SPECIALIZED KNOWLEDGE

Administer and maintain our VDI environment built on Omnissa Horizon (formerly VMware Horizon), including pools, golden images, and connection brokers

• Manage application publishing and delivery, ensuring apps are packaged, published, and performing reliably across the user base

• Design and maintain the underlying VMware infrastructure (vSphere/ESXi, vCenter) supporting the VDI environment

• Build and maintain golden images, master templates, and instant/linked clone pools

• Monitor VDI performance and capacity, troubleshooting latency, login, and session issues

• Manage profile and user data persistence solutions (e.g., App Volumes, Dynamic Environment Manager)

• Patch and update golden images and published app packages on a regular cadence

• Partner with Security to enforce access policies, MFA, and endpoint compliance for VDI sessions

• Document environment architecture, runbooks, and troubleshooting procedures

• Evaluate and recommend improvements to the VDI stack as user needs and scale grow

DESIRED ATTRIBUTES

Specialized knowledge:

  • Design thinker
  • Curious & Creative
  • Able to function in tactical and operational levels
  • Strong communicator and collaborator
  • Able to work collaboratively in a highly matrixed environment
  • Ability to effectively drive people, process, and technology changes
  • Proven record of effective leadership
  • Subject Matter Expert

Highly self-motivated with the ability to drive resources toward deadlines and manage ambiguity to effectively solve problems by embracing the health system's highly dynamic, constantly changing environment. Knowledge of regulatory and contractual compliance is beneficial. Experience leading large, complex projects across multiple functional departments. Experience in a complex healthcare organization is beneficial. The ability to explain complex technical ideas and issues to both technical and non-technical audiences is desired.

Day

40

IT Enterprise Endpoint Engineering

Duties & Responsibilities

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Business Solutions Analyst to join our dynamic CLO Business Solutions team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in planning, business analytics, workflow design, system integrations, and documentation, with proven experience in financial systems and the loan markets. This role will be instrumental in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions, ensuring the delivery of a high-quality client experience. As a senior member of the team, the successful candidate will bring 8–10 years of loan market experience, independently architect and drive large, complex projects with minimal oversight, serve as a subject-matter expert and mentor to other analysts, and represent UMB in client-facing and industry settings.

Design and implement highly efficient and customized workflows for new clients and product offerings, as well as internal partners

  • Gather internal team and external client requirements, document, and plan implementations
  • Work directly with our internal project managers and technology partners to implement large-scale technical solutions
  • Build line-of-business managed technical solutions using line-of-business tools
  • Partner with Operations, Relationship Management, and Analytics teams to enhance client solutions
  • Mitigate risks in operational workflows by redesigning or automating steps as necessary
  • Build data reconciliation models and data flows using available line-of-business tools
  • Work with clients and vendors to setup sFTP, ShareFile, automated data feeds, etc.
  • Manage all projects and deliverables in SharePoint, JIRA, OneNote, etc.
  • Build PowerBI reports for both external clients and internal teams
  • Build tools to ensure data integrity in our primary platform, Solvas
  • Educate business teams on client workflows, and products and services
  • Partner with senior team members and leadership on business strategy, including evaluating whether the team can operationally and technically support prospective new products, services, and asset classes
  • Architect and drive large, complex, cross-functional projects end-to-end with minimal oversight, from scoping and design through delivery, testing, and adoption
  • Establish reusable frameworks, standards, and best practices that scale across clients, asset classes, and product offerings (CLOs, CFOs, rated note feeders, ABLs, and private credit funds)
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert and mentor, providing technical guidance, design review, and coaching to other analysts on the team
  • Orchestrate and lead technology demonstrations for prospective clients, translating platform capabilities into tailored, client-specific solutions
  • Partner with Sales and Relationship Management throughout the prospecting and onboarding lifecycle to scope solutions and shape implementation approaches
  • Represent UMB at industry conferences and events, staying current on market practices, systems, and emerging technology, and sharing insights back with the team
  • Other duties as assigned

Knowledge & Skills

MINIMUM:

  • Advanced MS Excel
  • SQL (MSSQL, Oracle, SQLite, Access)
  • Deep understanding of corporate bank loans
  • Experience working with various structures of bank debt including CLOs, Interval funds, ABLs, Private debt, CFOs, Rated Debt Feeders
  • Deep understanding of full trade cycle including settlements, closings, loan administration, loan agency
  • Demonstrates strong client relationship management skills
  • Demonstrates ability to provide positive client experience through a variety of methods including associate engagement, technology, workflows, and processing
  • Demonstrates exceptional written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail, including top-tier communication across both internal and external (client-facing) audiences, with the ability to independently lead and own client communications without senior oversight
  • Proven ability to independently architect, lead, and deliver large, complex projects with minimal oversight
  • Demonstrated leadership presence, including experience presenting to and influencing clients, prospects, and senior internal stakeholders
  • Experience mentoring or coaching junior team members and setting technical standards

PREFERRED:

  • Power Query
  • Python for automation, data analysis, and short-term solutions
  • PowerBI
  • JIRA, Confluence, Trello, Miro, and Figma
  • Snowflake
  • Prefect for data pipelines
  • Familiarity with loan market systems such as ClearPar and Markit
  • APIs
  • Demonstrates strong operational knowledge of Corporate Trust processes and procedures

Requirements

MINIMUM:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 7 years financial industry technical projects or relevant experience, including a minimum of 5 years handling loan market related technical projects

PREFERRED:

  • Certified Corporate Trust Specialist (CCTS) or Corporate Trust Master Certification (CTMC)
  • Project management certification (e.g., PMP) or Agile/Scrum certification

Work Environment

Typical Office environment

Supervision/Management: No direct management accountabilities; provides mentorship, technical leadership, and design guidance to other analysts on the team

raw.description:
Overview

Who We Are: Qualfon is a global provider of omnichannel customer experience and business support solutions. From call center support to lead generation to ecommerce fulfillment, we support our clients and their customers throughout the customer journey. Our mission is to help as many people as possible pursue their total vocation - as individuals and as members of society by creating an ever-growing number of job opportunities as we strive to become the partner of choice for our clients. At Qualfon, you’ll find more than just a job, you’ll find a place to grow, develop your career, and be part of a supportive, purpose-driven team.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do:

As a Medi-Cal Claims Examiner, you will be responsible for reviewing, processing, and adjudicating suspended healthcare claims to ensure accurate and timely payment. You will apply Medi-Cal policies, regulations, and reimbursement guidelines while evaluating member eligibility, provider information, authorizations, benefits, and supporting documentation. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys analyzing claims, resolving issues, and working in a fast-paced healthcare environment while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and confidentiality.

  • Review and adjudicate suspended claims to ensure accurate processing and payment in accordance with established guidelines.
  • Confirm member eligibility, provider information, required authorizations, and covered benefits.
  • Evaluate medical records, claim forms, billing details, and supporting documentation to determine appropriate claim outcomes.
  • Identify discrepancies and resolve claim errors to ensure accurate adjudication.
  • Investigate and resolve claims-related issues while meeting established quality, productivity, and turnaround-time standards.
  • Apply Medi-Cal policies, regulations, reimbursement rules, and payment guidelines consistently and accurately.
  • Analyze claim information and interpret applicable policies and procedures to determine the appropriate resolution.
  • Safeguard protected health information and maintain compliance with HIPAA and organizational confidentiality requirements.
  • Partner with internal teams to address complex claims issues and escalate matters requiring additional review or resolution.
  • Accurately document claim reviews, actions taken, and final adjudication decisions in the appropriate systems

Qualifications

What You’ll Bring:

  • At least two (2) years of experience in Medicaid/Medi-Cal claims processing and adjudication.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare claims, medical terminology, and billing practices.
  • Familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding principles.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accuracy while meeting productivity and turnaround-time expectations.
  • Ability to understand, interpret, and apply policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and payment guidelines.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize competing tasks.
  • Ability to perform effectively in a high-volume, fast-paced production environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to independently research, analyze, and resolve claims issues using established guidelines and resources.
  • Proficiency with claims processing systems, Microsoft Office, and other computer-based applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to protect confidential information and appropriately handle sensitive member and provider data.

raw.description:
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Substation Civil Site Designer to work remotely supporting our Chicago, IL office.

In this role, you will work alongside Civil engineers to develop site design drawing packages and supporting documentation for electric utility substation projects. Projects range from greenfield substations to brownfield expansions and require coordination with multiple engineering disciplines. (While substation experience is preferred, it is not required)

Responsibilities Include:

  • Develop new and modify existing substation civil site plan drawings.

  • Prepare grading, drainage, and stormwater management plans.

  • Develop erosion and sediment control plans in accordance with local and state requirements.

  • Prepare roadway, access drive, and site layout plans.

  • Perform earthwork grading and cut/fill balancing using Civil 3D or OpenRoads/MicroStation workflows.

  • Perform AutoTURN analyses for construction and maintenance vehicle access.

  • Prepare utility layouts including storm sewer, sanitary, and water service plans where required.

  • Develop permit-ready civil drawing packages for utility and agency review.

  • Assist with preparation of permitting exhibits and support environmental and jurisdictional permitting efforts.

  • Coordinate with surveyors, geotechnical engineers, structural engineers, and substation electrical teams.

  • Review civil-related vendor drawings and incorporate comments as required.

  • Assist with quantity takeoffs and preparation of project deliverables.

  • Apply applicable client standards, local agency requirements, and industry best practices to all assignments.

Substation Civil Site Designer Qualifications:

  • Level 3:

    • Associate’s degree or technical diploma in Civil Engineering Technology, Drafting Technology, or related field.

    • Minimum 2 years of civil site design experience using MicroStation.

  • Level 4:

    • Associate’s degree or technical diploma in Civil Engineering Technology, Drafting Technology, or related field.

    • Minimum 3 years of civil site design experience using MicroStation.

  • Strong proficiency with MicroStation (required).

  • Experience developing civil site plans for utility, industrial, commercial, or municipal projects.

  • Working knowledge of grading design and earthwork calculations.

  • Experience preparing erosion and sediment control plans.

  • Familiarity with stormwater management principles and permitting requirements.

  • Experience performing AutoTURN vehicle turning analyses.

  • Understanding of site development permitting processes and agency coordination.

  • Ability to interpret survey and geotechnical information.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel.

  • Strong communication and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work both independently and within multidisciplinary engineering teams.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality deliverables.

Substation Site Civil Designer Preferred Experience/Additional information:

  • Experience supporting electric utility substation projects.

  • Familiarity with utility client standards.

  • Experience with HEC-RAS, Hydraflow, HydroCAD, or similar hydrology software.

  • Knowledge of SWPPP preparation and stormwater permitting requirements.

  • Experience coordinating local, county, and state permitting agencies.

HealthEdge® offers AI-powered operational infrastructure for health insurance companies, guaranteeing an enduring financial edge in an increasingly competitive market. We're experiencing strong market momentum, with a growing number of health plans choosing HealthEdge to modernize their operations and compete more effectively. As we expand, we're investing in the people who power that growth, making this a pivotal moment to join us and shape the future of healthcare technology. Learn more at HealthEdge.com.

At UST HealthProof, you will join a fast paced, growing company in our mission to reshape the future of health insurance through significantly reducing administrative costs and building better healthcare experiences for our health plans customers and their members. By creating a modern, cloud based, Best-In-Class core administration ecosystem, we have made healthcare more affordable and helped our health plans operate more efficiently. Through member and provider touchpoints with less friction, we have created real impact for members.

UST HealthProof is run by leaders with strong health plan and technology backgrounds who have start-up mindsets and an environment of support where individual growth is nurtured. You will be supporting our proven core admin solutions and business process-as-a-service (BPaaS) operations to provide transparency, improve operational efficiency, and break down operational barriers to scale and drive strategic growth.

UST HealthProof is looking for Claims Examiner II, reporting to the Claims Team Leader. The Claims Examiner II is responsible for the adjudication of healthcare claims utilizing specific policies and procedures. This role is responsible for reviewing data within the claims processing system, to determine if services rendered were appropriate and benefit coverage criteria were met. The Claims Examiner II is accountable for reviewing the adjudication system edits to determine whether to pay the claim and/or line item(s).

As a Claims Examiner II at UST HealthProof, this is your opportunity to

  • Be responsible for processing assigned claims based on client-specified guidelines or as directed by the team leader
  • Be responsible for meeting productivity targets, financial and procedural accuracy standards as established by management
  • Mentor junior members of the team
  • Collaborate with other team members on special projects as assigned by the team leads; special projects can include process documentation development, training, quality audits, assisting with surge activity for the client(s), or any other project as determined by the team leader
  • Knowledge base around physician practices and hospital coding, billing and medical terminology, CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10, UB04, CMS 1500, authorizations, medical terminology, and concepts of healthcare
  • Establish and maintain an appropriate level of communication with management to address issues and concerns and take preventive measures that ensure processing accuracy and quality
  • Participate in projects assigned by the team leader; these projects may include provider data, authorizations, enrollment, or other activities

You bring:

  • High School degree required
  • 1 – 3 years healthcare claims processing experience
  • Solid understanding and ability to analyse claim data
  • ICD-10 CPT and HCPCS coding, is a plus
  • Willingness to learn new skills
  • Team collaborator
  • Strong work ethic

For this role, we value:

  • The ability to adapt quickly to a fast-paced environment
  • A self-starter and quick learner
  • Team player with an ability to collaborate

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
  • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

Head of Product, Connected Experience

About Safeguard Global: We enable global expansion without the risk.

Safeguard Global has been at the forefront of global workforce enablement since we pioneered centralised global payments in 2008 and launched the employer of record (EOR) category globally in 2010. And we haven't stopped there.

Today, with our 500+ in-country HR experts, cutting-edge technology, and comprehensive solutions, we've helped over 2,000 organisations hire, recruit, pay, and manage employees in 170+ countries.

Because we created this category, we've learned that successful global expansion isn't driven by technology alone. It requires deep global expertise. We call this the marriage of expert and technology, human when it matters.

This means we have the people and the technology to ensure 100% compliance with local, regional, national, and international laws. Together, this ethos and our solutions portfolio allow businesses to scale up or down wherever, however, and whenever they want to expand, without the risk.

Overview of the role

We're looking for a Head of Product, Connected Experience to own the experiences shared across every application: things like home, user access, and knowledge, together with the integrations that connect us to the outside world. What makes them shared is that every application touches or relies on them.

The role is accountable for the experience, delivery, and outcome achievement across those shared surfaces, and for the standard other product teams build to wherever their work touches them, even though most of those teams sit outside your direct reporting line. You'll translate that target experience, combined with the product strategies set by the Directors of Product into a prioritised order of work; leading the product managers who deliver it and ensuring we deliver on business and customer experience objectives.

Several of our biggest growth opportunities for 2027 sit in this area.

What you will be responsible for

Shared surfaces and standards

  • Own the experience across the shared surfaces and services that sit between applications

  • Own the governance of shared components with the Lead Designer, so that changes to capability every team depends on are made deliberately and once

  • Own how external systems connect to the platform, through integrations

  • Own regulatory and compliance obligations as product requirements within your area, particularly where integrations, white labelling, and access to client data are concerned, working with legal and the in-country teams so that they are designed in rather than retrofitted

Prioritisation and roadmap

  • Translate the platform strategy and commercial priorities into a prioritised order of work for your area

  • Feed that prioritisation into the single prioritised roadmap owned by the SVP, Product

  • Recommend what is built, what is deferred, and what is retired within your area, and secure agreement with the SVP, Product and the Directors of Product

  • Build the case for significant investment, including the value expected, the payback, and the trade-off against the alternatives

Delivery

  • Hold accountability for delivery against commitment, on time and to the quality bar set in the definition of done

  • Work hand in hand with engineering and design leadership, from the earliest shaping of an idea through to release, so that trade-offs between client need, technical feasibility, and cost are made together

  • Work with sales, marketing, customer success, finance, and legal so that what we build is understood, sellable, supportable, and compliant on the day it launches

  • Sequence work that other teams depend on so that shared capability lands ahead of the work requiring it

  • Identify conflicts between applications early, while there is still time to resolve them

Customer insight and product performance

  • Build the relationships, with clients, integration partners, and internal teams, that sustain a continuous understanding of customer and internal pain points, and of the opportunities they point to

  • Ground product decisions in client insight, usage data, and market evidence

  • Raise the standard of discovery and validation across your teams

  • Define the expected outcome for each investment and own the value delivered against it

  • Identify opportunities to cross-sell across the platform, drawing on usage and adoption data, and work with sales to act on them

  • Act as the product expert in senior client, prospect, and partner conversations, and represent the platform externally where it helps us win and keep clients

Team leadership

  • Line manage the product managers within your area

  • Set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and address performance issues early

  • Work with each product manager to understand their individual development needs, and take a coaching approach to growing their capability

  • Drive AI adoption where it creates the best outcome, recognising that it serves some tasks well and others poorly, and help the product team keep pace with how the role of product is rapidly changing

What will give you an advantage

  • Eight or more years in product

  • A proven track record of driving growth and commercial outcomes from product teams, including through product led growth

  • Proven experience owning platform, integration, or API products in B2B SaaS, with external developers or partners as users

  • A record of setting and holding shared standards across teams outside your reporting line, whether a design system, a component library, or an integration pattern

  • Technical enough to hold your own in a conversation on integrations, data flows, and data products, without needing to be an engineer yourself

  • Experience of building products in a regulated environment, where compliance shapes what can be built

  • At least five years leading people, including globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones

Primary performance metrics

  • Delivery:commitments delivered on time and to quality

  • Business impact:value delivered against the outcomes committed at the point of investment

  • Experience:platform NPS

  • Adoption:how widely the shared surfaces are used across the platform

Baselines and annual targets are set with the SVP, Product at the start of each financial year.

Competencies

  • Strategic thinking:sets a direction for the shared platform that connects client need, market direction, and commercial goals

  • Systems thinking:designs each service around what matters most to the customer, and focuses only on the work that delivers value

  • Technical fluency:holds a credible conversation with engineering leadership on integration patterns, data, and access

  • Delivery leadership:maintains a predictability and quality bar across multiple teams without becoming a bottleneck

  • Communication:strong written and verbal communicator at all levels of the organisation, from SLT to team

  • People development:understands what each individual needs and coaches them to grow

  • Influencing:gets other product teams to adopt standards for the shared surfaces, without formal authority over how they run their own area

  • Commercial judgement:determines what is worth building next, and evidences the case

Key personal attributes

  • Grit and determination:moves work forward despite obstacles, and does not give up easily

  • Curiosity:actively seeks out different points of view, customer needs, and the problems worth solving

  • A leader and a doer:operates strategically while staying close to the detail

  • Warm, open, honest, and fun to work with

We are hiring this position across multiple countries; compensation varies by hiring location. For target markets located within the European Union (EU), base salaries start from (Gross):

Spain: €100,000.00

Portugal: €95,000.00

Who we are and what we do:

Safeguard Global is…Global! We help 1500+ companies hire, manage, and pay employees in 170+ countries. Join us to meet diverse talent, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe. ✈️

Our Global Benefits

  • 👨‍💻 Autonomy & Flexibility (Work in Any Way): Remote first, with the flexibility to include school runs and gym breaks in your schedule all while maintaining a high standard of work.
  • 🧑‍🍼 Bonding Leave: Enjoy paid leave to bond with your new family member.
  • 🎁 2 Charitable Days: Contribute to causes you believe in.
  • 🏆 Reward & Recognition Program: Be rewarded for your success and championing our values.
  • 💰 Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan.
  • 🏢 Coworking Space: Need to meet with a client, utilize admin services or just get out of the house? We’ve got you covered with flexible workspace options based on location.

Why become a Guardian:

  • ✈️ International Environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.
  • ⭐ Our Culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.
  • 📚 Learning: We support your continuous growth by providing access to 2 learning platforms, where you can learn at your own pace.

Next Steps:

To express your interest, please click on the following link. We wish you the best with your application. Our Guardian promise to you is to keep in touch to arrange the next stage should your application meet the position's requirements, and or a gentle update if you have been unsuccessful at this time.

Welcome to the Future of Work!

At Safeguard Global, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and Guardians.

raw.title: Cellular Therapy Account Director (CTAD), Southwest (So.CA, AZ, NM)
raw.excerpt: Your missionPierre Fabre is a large private French multinational pharmaceutical organization that is building a new US division with a focus on rare diseases and oncology products.
raw.description:
Your mission

Pierre Fabre is a large private French multinational pharmaceutical organization that is building a new US division with a focus on rare diseases and oncology products. We are looking for creative, highly motivated individuals to help to drive the successful launch of tabelecleucel (Tab-cel), as part of the initial Cellular Therapy Director (CTAD) team, you will be focused on delivering results with innovative solutions for complex patients suffering from a devastating rare disease, Epstein-Barr Virus Positive Post Transplant Lymphoproliferative Disease (EBV+ PTLD). Patients with a history of bone marrow or solid organ transplant can suffer from this rare, often deadly lymphoma. This is an opportunity for “builders” those who are looking to contribute to the creation of a new US organization, with a potentially transformative therapy, and we are looking for candidates that have a growth mindset and thrive in a start-up environment that will be scaling up the Pierre Fabre presence in the US pharmaceuticals market. We value individuals who exhibit behaviors such as team collaboration, humility, innovative thinking, and a patient-centric approach to the business.

In the preapproval phase, the CTAD will be responsible for leading disease awareness efforts, developing relationships with both the clinical and non-clinical experts to understand unmet need and patient journey, as well as leading the onboarding process for launching an allogeneic cell therapy. Post-approval, the CTADs will be responsible for appropriately driving demand and working cross functionally to support utilization and treatment experience of Tab-cel within institutions in their assigned territory.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Operate in compliance with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of Pierre Fabre activities

  • Effectively navigate complex account environments by identifying and understanding the needs and challenges of diverse stakeholders and proactively collaborating with other internal functions: medical, value and access, and cell therapy operations to provide targeted support.

  • Integrate customer insights and analytical data to design and execute strategic account plans. Develop a deep understanding of customer dynamics and market trends to identify opportunities, uncover barriers to treatment, and drive actionable insights.

  • Equip treatment center staff with process training that will eliminate barriers to use and optimize operational workflows so that appropriate patients have access to products.

Pre-approval: Disease state education, Site of Care onboarding, Market mapping and research

  • Identify and engage with medical experts in the fields of Cell Therapy, bone marrow transplant (BMT), lymphoma, and solid organ transplantation (SOT) who manage Post Transplant Lymphoproliferative Disease (PTLD) to understand proliferation of disease and referral patterns

  • Understand process at cell therapy and transplant centers and engage on process mapping and potential onboarding requirements for allogeneic cell therapies

  • Educate physicians on severity of disease, unmet medical need, and current standard of care and patient journey

  • Create and maintain detailed site account plans

  • Work closely, coordinating with other PFP functions to ensure an efficient, professional customer experience that support expedited access to Tab-celEbvallo for appropriate patients

  • Institutional mapping which includes understanding of operational process, patient flow within institutions, and patient referral networks

  • Successfully execute territory business plans which include account specific KPIs and tactics

  • Partner with external stakeholders at sites; service line directors, administrators, coordinators, and pharmacy committees, transplant administrators, and medical societies and map relevant processes

  • Collaborate with marketing in the development of US promotional materials to prepare for launch

  • Facilitating cross-functional relationships and ownership of relationship with key commercial stakeholders within target institutions

  • Provide support at professional meetings, including staffing exhibits, reporting on scientific sessions and facilitating meetings with medical experts

  • Account leadership: drive collaboration and communication with internal field-facing cross functional teams, market access, medical affairs, and cell therapy technical operations team

  • Operate in compliance with all laws, regulations and policies that govern the conduct of Pierre Fabre activities and adhere to all US State and Federal Regulations

Post Approval: (Includes all Pre-Approval Activities

  • Competitively promote Tab-celEbvallo through a deep knowledge of the EBV + PTLD landscape, product knowledge and best-in-class clinical expertise.

  • Share relevant account and HCP insights with cross-functional partners, highlighting business trends, competitive shifts, and changes in the therapeutic landscape. Support stakeholders to ensure both their and the patient experience is positive and seamless.

  • Drive appropriate utilization of Pierre Fabre products through exchange on product attributes and providing a seamless customer experience

  • Educate on efficacy and safety of Tab-cel for adoption in appropriate patients

  • Create a sense of urgency to treat patients with Tab-cel by utilizing approved promotional materials

Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned as required based on evolving business needs.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s Degree

  • At least 10 years of experience within the biopharma industry

  • Deep expertise in of the following areas is required: cell or gene therapy service lines

  • Demonstrated experience in participating in a collaborative and complex matrix environment

  • Ability to understand and covey complex treatment modalities and demonstrated high scientific aptitude

  • Sales experience in ultra rare disease, ideally CGT

  • Ability to appropriately access and handle business information in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and / or Pierre Fabre policies

  • A passion for making a difference in the lives of patients

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Launch experience in a high acuity therapeutic area such as ultra rare disease

  • Existing relationships in cell therapy, bone marrow transplantation, solid organ transplantation service lines

  • Experience managing large geographies

  • Experience in rare oncology and/ or transplant setting

  • Demonstrated record of successful account management in large academic institution

LOCATION: US, Remote with regular daily and overnight travel expected within given business territory up to 70%

Compensation and Benefits:

Anticipated Salary Range: $170,000 - $250,000

This range represents the base annual full-time salary for all positions within the applicable job grade. The actual salary offer will depend on a range of factors including experience, education, location, and other relevant qualifications. This position is also eligible for a Pierre Fabre bonus, commission, or incentive program in addition to the base pay.

Employees will be eligible to participate in a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, voluntary benefits, a 401(k) retirement plan, a generous PTO policy, paid company holidays, and paid parental leave. Additional offerings include employee discounts on our products, professional development opportunities, and access to mental health and wellness programs

Pierre Fabre

Pierre Fabre has been recognized by Forbes as one of the "World's Best Employers" for the 3rd year running.

True to My Nature

Who you are ?

Pierre Fabre is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant because of race, creed, color, age, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender expression and identity, disability, genetic information, veteran status, military status, application for military service or any other class protected by state or federal law.

We are convinced that diversity is a source of fulfillment, social balance and complementarity for our employees, which is why our offers are open to all, without restriction.

raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for a versatile, highly skilled Graphic Designer to join the Tendem project (**) andcreate high-quality visual assets for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, layout design, and branding to transform ideas into professional, polished creative assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, layout design, and creating diverse marketing materials.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Graphic Designer, your focus will be on layouts, infographics, social media templates, and overall visual polish. We need a versatile, all-around graphic designer to handle diverse visual tasks, utilizing industry-standard tools to structure information cleanly and effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the creation of clean layouts, modern infographics, and establish a clear visual hierarchy to ensure readable and engaging content.
  • Design highly engaging, reusable templates for various social media channels, as well as impactful one-pagers.
  • Elevate everyday materials by working deeply with advanced typography, grid systems, and thoughtful composition.
  • Transform raw data and concepts into professional, polished visual assets tailored to specific marketing and communication goals.
  • Enforce design quality standards through systematic verification of visual alignment, color usage, and layout consistency prior to delivery.

Important note

Please submit your CV in English. Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with examples of your work — applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.

This is project-based freelance work. Tasks are available only when projects are active. You may be invited to one or more projects depending on your profile and current opportunities.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, complete the qualification process, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills — on your own schedule.

Requirements

Educational qualifications

  • At least 1-2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, digital design, or visual communications is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong, diverse portfolio showcasing a wide variety of formats (such as social media graphics, marketing collateral, and one-pagers). We are looking for versatile specialists with an exceptional grasp of typography, visual composition, and grid systems. An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented approach is essential, along with the ability to work independently to solve visual challenges.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Layout & Typography: Exceptional grasp of typography, precise grid systems, and visual composition to elevate everyday materials.
  • Visual Asset Creation: Proven ability to structure information cleanly through modern infographics and compelling social media templates.
  • Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma to handle a wide spectrum of visual tasks.
  • Format Versatility: Seamlessly switch between designing impactful one-pagers and highly engaging digital templates, adapting to the constraints of each medium.

Additional requirements

  • An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Strong dedication to delivering visually polished, professional-grade assets.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to manage diverse visual tasks simultaneously.
  • Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with graphic design examples. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant graphic design cases, will not be considered.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $34 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

raw.description:
TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Guided by our vision, we are leveraging the power of our leading edge technology and focusing on the uniqueness of each individual to create the future of health. As a global-leading health and well-being provider – encompassing physical, mental and financial health – TELUS Health is improving health outcomes for consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, employers and employees.

TELUS Health is dedicated to helping employees reach their professional goals through internal promotion and development opportunities. We are seeking an experienced Senior Consultant Relations Mangers to lead consultant growth and expand market share across the United States and globally, supporting organizations with both domestic and multinational footprints.


This role is central to driving sales through direct broker/client partnerships, and strategic alliances while collaborating cross-functionally with Business Development Representatives, Account Management, Marketing, Operations, and Finance teams. You will play a key role in shaping growth within our Integrated Health Solutions portfolio, including EAP (Employee Assistance Programs), helping organizations improve employee wellbeing through innovative and impactful solutions.

Our team and what we'll accomplish together

TELUS Health's Integrated Health Solutions team is transforming how organizations support employee wellbeing through innovative EAP, virtual care, and behavioral health solutions. In this role, you'll lead our expansion across the US and global markets by building trusted partnerships with brokers and consultants—positioning TELUS Health as the preferred vendor of choice while directly driving new business growth and market share.

What you'll do

  • Build and nurture strategic relationships with key stakeholders at target brokerage and consulting firms, establishing TELUS Health as a known, trusted partner across national and regional players

  • Lead the vendor credentialing and validation process, managing due diligence, security, and compliance requirements to secure preferred carrier and approved vendor status that unlocks access to broker producers and clients

  • Drive new business opportunities by securing internal broker introductions, speaking slots, and placement in RFP and finalist processes, converting broker credibility into qualified client pipeline in partnership with sales teams

  • Deliver training and enablement sessions that educate broker teams on TELUS Health's EAP, virtual care, behavioral health, and absence management solutions, ensuring consultants can confidently position our offerings to their clients

  • Maintain disciplined stakeholder mapping, relationship tracking, and pipeline reporting using Salesforce CRM, providing leadership with clear visibility into channel health, credentialing status, and growth opportunities by firm

  • Partner with marketing and sales leadership to develop firm-specific engagement plans, co-branded materials, and events that reinforce TELUS Health's credibility and differentiation across the broker community

  • Represent the voice of the channel by gathering broker feedback and market intelligence, sharing insights with product and sales teams to refine positioning and identify market gaps TELUS Health is uniquely positioned to fill

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in consultant relations, broker channel management, vendor credentialing, or account management within healthcare, benefits, or employee wellbeing solutions

  • Established network and credibility within the US broker and consultant community, with direct experience engaging national and regional firms

  • Proven track record of success in complex, multinational sales environments with multiple stakeholders

  • Demonstrated expertise in building new relationships from the ground up and navigating firm structures to secure vendor validation and preferred carrier standing

  • Proven consultative selling and presentation skills with the ability to manage complex sales cycles autonomously from end-to-end

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong drive for growth, results, and market expansion

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and time management skills with high professionalism and business acumen

  • Ability and willingness to travel throughout the US region

Great-to-haves

  • Existing broker network or established book of business within the benefits consulting space

  • Experience in digital health, SaaS, or services-based solution selling

  • MBA or advanced business degree

Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary: $125,000 – $130,000

On-Target Earnings (OTE): $180,000 – $190,000 (uncapped commission potential)

Benefits: Comprehensive health, wellness, and retirement programs

Work Environment: Remote / home-based position with flexible, collaborative support

Why TELUS Health?

● Purpose-driven impact: Help millions of individuals and families improve their mental health and wellbeing through industry-leading EAP and integrated health solutions

● Global reach: Partner with leading North American organizations and multinational enterprises, supporting complex workforces across diverse markets

● Market leadership: Join a recognized leader in employee wellbeing and mental health services, backed by continued investment in digital health and AI-driven solutions

● People-first culture: Experience TELUS's commitment to employee engagement, inclusion, and creating a supportive workplace where you can thrive

● Career growth: Access internal mobility, leadership development, and advancement opportunities within a high-growth organization

● Community impact: Contribute to meaningful causes through TELUS Days of Giving and initiatives supporting mental health awareness and accessibility

A bit about us

We’re a people-focused, customer-first, purpose-driven team who works together every day to innovate and do good. We improve lives through our technology solutions and foster a culture of innovation that empowers team members to solve complex problems and create remarkable human outcomes in a digital world.

TELUS Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer that aims to foster an inclusive culture that embraces diversity. It is our policy to hire without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sex, marital status, age, disability, sexual orientation or veteran status.We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities, as required, during the recruitment process.

By applying to this role, you understand and agree that your information will be shared with the TELUS Group of Companies’ Talent Acquisition team(s) and/or any leader(s) who will be part of the selection process.

JOB PURPOSE

The Bids Writer is responsible for creating compelling, compliant, and high-quality proposals and tender submissions that clearly articulate the company’s value proposition.

This role involves collaborating with internal teams, understanding client requirements, and producing persuasive content that maximizes win rates.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Essential

  • Previous bid writing experience, or similar
  • Excellent research and interpretation skills
  • Skills in questioning, writing, editing and checking/reviewing
  • Exceptional attention to detail – taking a proactive and detail-oriented approach
  • Excellent time-management and organisation skills
  • Excellent communicator – strong interpersonal and collaboration skills.
  • Excellent IT skills – including proficiency in all MS Office applications
  • Strong academic background. Degree level desirable [English Language, Historyy, Psychology, or similar] or, if you have bid writing experience - GCSE English A/B or 6/7 and Maths C/4, as a minimum.

Desirable

  • Proven bid team involvement
  • Industry experience – Builders Merchants or similar
  • Public Sector knowledge – Local Authority bidding
  • Bid qualification – APMP, Shipley or equivalent
  • CRM / Database experience

KEY RESULT AREAS

Capable of writing and creating bespoke responses with the aim of securing Business tenders within the public sector, this includes;

Bid Writing/Proposal Development:

  • Delivering on-time bespoke documents - by managing others and self, effectively.

– Write, edit, and format bids and proposal documents for public sector opportunities.

– Ensure all submissions meet client specifications, deadlines, and compliance requirements

Content Management:

– Working with the rest of the Bid Team to develop and maintain a library of standard responses, case studies, and templates.

– Tailor content to reflect client needs and project objectives.

  • Preparing presentations for Sales Managers to support post-submission interviews.

Quality Assurance:

  • Delivering high standards of work, ensuring all documents are free from errors and professionally presented - ensuring the layout of the documents is correct and to a high standard – in line with agreed corporate style guides.

– Proofreading and reviewing Bid Responses/Proposals for clarity, accuracy, and alignment with brand guidelines.

– Implementing best practices for bid writing and presentations.

Research & Analysis:

– Analyze tender documents and identify key requirements and evaluation criteria.

– Conduct market and competitor research to strengthen proposal positioning.

Compliance & Governance:

– Ensure adherence to procurement regulations and company policies.

– Maintain confidentiality and integrity throughout the bid process.

- Knowing at all times where we are against deadlines and communicating accordingly, managing these deadlines.

COMMUNICATIONS AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

Creating an effective network and building relationships with colleagues, to call upon if required to support you in achieving a deadline - adapting style for different team members, to maximise their output.

  • Work closely with sales, technical, and operational teams to gather accurate information.
  • Coordinating input from subject matter experts and ensure consistency across documents.

This is a national role is the sense of supporting the business and working on tenders on a national basis ranging from contracts worth £100K to £10million plus per annum

No Reportees

Driven. Engaging. Innovative. Do these words motivate you? If so, then we want to talk with you. Academy of Art University offers a rewarding employment experience for those who excel in a dynamic environment and who can consistently deliver high-caliber customer service. We thrive on ingenuity and pursue ideas every day that lead to extraordinary opportunities for tomorrow. Apply here for your next career!

Are you ready to bring your energy and expertise to a dynamic team? Academy of Art University is seeking an Executive Assistant to support our Chief Academic Officer. Discover an inspiring career path at one of the country's most innovative institutions for higher art education.

The Executive Assistant to the Chief Academic Officer provides high-level administrative and operational support to the Chief Academic Officer. This position plays an important role in Academy of Art University’s academic mission. As the Executive Assistant to the Chief Academic Officer, this position will act as a primary liaison for academic divisions and executive offices.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee daily functions for the office of the Chief Academic Officer in effort to optimize and maximize communication / efficiencies throughout the organization.

  • Manage internal and external communications by sending timely correspondence on behalf of the office and coordinating logistics for meetings and other appointments.

  • Prepare and brief the Chief Academic Officer on their daily schedule. Compile documents needed for respective meetings. Ensure the Chief Academic Officer remains on schedule.

  • Organize, by date and priority, requests received from the Executive Office for the Chief Academic Officer.

  • Track the timing of approvals and responses and keep the Chief Academic Officer aware of outstanding matters.

raw.description:
Overview

Who we are—

Transcat is a dynamic, innovative, growing company that has been recognized as the leading calibration and compliance services provider in North America and beyond. With over 1,000 employees—in technical, consulting, operational, sales, finance, and corporate roles—we have stood the test of time by delivering on our Trust in Every Measure promise to our customers in vital industries, including life sciences, aerospace, defense, energy, and utilities. We fulfill this promise through our employees, who live Our Values every day, the Transcat Way. Our employees are at the center of the rewarding, challenging, and life-changing work we do for our customers and those they serve. Are you ready to join a company where the work you do makes a difference, and where you can grow in your career?

Here’s what Transcat has to offer—

  • Work that matters
  • A values-based culture where people care about each other and the work they do together
  • Flexibility
  • Training and development to accelerate learning and career advancement
  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including paid time off, health insurance, tuition reimbursement, retirement, stock purchase plan, and MORE!
  • Salary range is $150,000 - $200,000

The Service Segment Director is responsible for owning the commercial and strategic performance of defined calibration services categories. This role drives revenue growth, profitability, and market differentiation through strategy development, pricing leadership, service portfolio optimization, and cross-functional influence. The scope of this role requires strong collaboration and influence across Sales, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Quality, and Technology to deliver category outcomes. This role is remote with travel to our Rochester headquarters location required.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

1. Category Strategy and Market Leadership

  • Develop and execute a three–five year category strategy aligned with company growth objectives
  • Define target segments (e.g., biomedical, CBLs, data/AI, flow, GSE, and pipettes) and customer value propositions
  • Analyze market trends, regulatory requirements, and competitor positioning
  • Identify and prioritize growth and margin growth opportunities (e.g., new services, geographic expansion)
  • Lead service differentiation initiatives (e.g., turnaround time, compliance assurance, value-added analytics)

2. P&L Influence & Strategy

  • Strategically optimize category performance and profitability by steering revenue mix, gross margin expansion, and cost-to-serve improvements.
  • Design and implement pricing strategies, including discounting guardrails and contract structures to maximize deal profitability.
  • Champion pricing discipline across sales teams to ensure alignment with organizational margin targets.

3. Service Portfolio Management

  • Define and continuously optimize the calibration and solutions service portfolio
  • Rationalize low-margin or low-demand offerings
  • Develop bundled service offerings and subscription models
  • Introduce new services based on customer needs, industry standards, or technology advancements
  • Ensure alignment with operational capabilities and quality requirements

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Influence

  • Partner with Sales to enable growth and margin improvement across the service portfolio through training, tools, process discipline, and value messaging
  • Work with Operations/Labs to align capacity, turnaround times, and cost structures
  • Collaborate with Quality/Compliance to ensure adherence to accreditation and regulatory standards
  • Engage Marketing to develop targeted campaigns and thought leadership
  • Coordinate with Distribution and Rentals for equipment, standards, and vendor optimization
  • Partner with IT to ensure technology infrastructure and software assets strategically support overarching business objectives.
  • Influence senior stakeholders to drive alignment on priorities, investments, and trade-offs

5. Customer and Commercial Excellence

  • Act as the voice of the customer
  • Support key account strategy and large/strategic deal structuring
  • Develop standardized proposals, pricing frameworks, and service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Drive customer retention and expansion through improved service value

Qualifications

Essential Skills and Competencies

Strategic and Commercial

  • Category strategy development
  • Pricing strategy and value-based selling
  • Market and competitive analysis

Leadership

  • Strong influencing and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to drive alignment across diverse teams without direct reporting lines
  • Adept at translating complex strategies into clear, persuasive visual and verbal narratives for top-tier stakeholders

Analytical

  • Data-driven decision making
  • Financial modeling and business case development

Operational Understanding

  • Knowledge of service delivery models and cost structures in technical service environments

Strategic Attributes

  • Adaptable and resilient: Thrives in complex, matrixed environments
  • Analytical and decisive: Uses data to make informed, timely decisions
  • Commercially driven: Relentless focus on growth and profitability
  • Continuous improvement mindset: Seeks efficiency, innovation, and differentiation
  • Customer-centric: Deep understanding of customer needs and value drivers
  • Enterprise thinker: Balances category optimization with broader company objectives
  • Highly collaborative: Builds trust and alignment across functions
  • Influential leader: Drives outcomes with and without formal authority

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business or a related field
  • 5+ years of successful experience in service industry

Bonus Experience

  • Experience in a related industry (e.g., test equipment, distribution, calibration)
  • Experience with strategic sourcing
  • Leadership experience

Equal Opportunity and Non-Discrimination

Transcat is an equal-opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination based on any protected status. As required by United States law, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, disability, genetic predisposition or carrier status, national origin, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), status as a protected veteran, or as a member of any other protected group or activity under federal, state, and local law.

We will make reasonable accommodations for employees with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their position unless doing so poses an undue hardship to the company or a direct threat to health or safety.

Contingencies

All offers of employment are contingent upon successfully completing all pre-employment requirements, which include verification of identity and employment eligibility, and when applicable, a motor vehicle driving record report.

raw.title: Product Manager, Stablecoin & Digital Assets
raw.excerpt: Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform.
raw.description:
Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.
Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).

You'll own Jeeves' stablecoin and digital asset strategy—defining how blockchain rails transform cross-border payments, treasury management, and settlement for global businesses. This role requires someone who is crypto-obsessed and deeply familiar with the stablecoin ecosystem: issuance and reserve models, on/off-ramp mechanics, fiat rail interoperability, and institutional adoption trends. We want someone who has built stablecoin or crypto payment products at a stablecoin issuer, crypto exchange, cross-border payment platform, or fintech building on blockchain rails.

Location: This role is based out of Argentina, and is a full-time remote position.

What You'll Do

    Stablecoin Product Strategy

    • Own the stablecoin product roadmap: which rails to build on, which stablecoins to support, and how they integrate into payments and treasury workflows

    • Build institutional-grade infrastructure that abstracts blockchain complexity while preserving speed and cost advantages for end users

    • Drive the full product lifecycle from ideation through launch, collaborating with engineering, design, legal, compliance, and commercial teams

      • Cross-Border Payments & Treasury

      • Build products that let businesses send, receive, convert, and hold stablecoins alongside fiat across USD, EUR, BRL, MXN, and local currency corridors

      • Design seamless on/off-ramp flows that feel as simple as traditional banking, even for users who have never touched crypto

      • Ensure interoperability with fiat rails (ACH, Fedwire, SWIFT, SEPA, PIX, SPEI) so stablecoins become a natural extension of existing payment infrastructure

        • Compliance, Risk & Custody

        • Navigate US state licensing, MiCA, and LatAm crypto regulations to ship compliant products in every market we serve

        • Embed AML/KYC, Travel Rule, and transaction monitoring requirements into the product from day one

        • Evaluate wallet infrastructure, custodians, and key management solutions that meet institutional-grade security standards

          • Partnerships & Go-to-Market

          • Evaluate and manage partnerships with stablecoin issuers, liquidity providers, custodians, and banking partners

          • Enable Sales and Customer Success to position stablecoin products and close deals with CFOs and treasury teams

          • Ship, measure, and iterate—track adoption metrics and ruthlessly prioritize based on data and business impact

What We're Looking For:

    Required

    • 4+ years in product management at a stablecoin infrastructure provider, crypto exchange, cross-border payments company, or fintech building on blockchain rails

    • Deep stablecoin expertise: issuance and redemption mechanics, reserve models, on-chain settlement, ecosystem dynamics, and how stablecoins interact with treasury flows and FX

    • Strong understanding of fiat rails: ACH, wires, RTP, SWIFT, SEPA, PIX, SPEI—and how reconciliation, settlement timing, and fiat conversions work alongside stablecoin flows

    • Blockchain infrastructure literacy: EVM chains, Solana, Layer 2s, wallet architecture, key management, and custody. Able to converse with engineers on API docs and system design

    • Regulatory fluency: AML/KYC frameworks, Travel Rule, MiCA, US state-by-state licensing, and how compliance requirements vary by jurisdiction

    • Analytical rigor: comfortable with SQL, dashboards, and building data-driven business cases

    • Exceptional communication: can write strategy memos and product specs that align cross-functional stakeholders

      • Strongly Preferred

      • Track record of owning complex, regulated financial products from concept through production at scale

      • Relationships in the stablecoin ecosystem—issuers, custodians, liquidity providers, or regulators

      • Experience with multi-market products serving LatAm, US, and/or European customers

      • Familiarity with developer platforms, API design, and ecosystem-driven products

      • Background in traditional payments or banking

Why This Role Matters:

    Cross-border payments move $150+ trillion annually through slow, expensive, opaque systems. Stablecoins are the most promising technology to fix this—but most stablecoin products today are built for crypto-native users, not the finance teams at global businesses who move billions daily. At Jeeves, you'll bridge that gap and shape how thousands of global businesses adopt stablecoin-powered finance.
