Engagement Overview

Dashlabs.ai is retaining fractional Growth and Industry Consultants to advise on and accelerate platform adoption across the Philippine healthcare ecosystem. This independent consultancy role is designed for senior healthcare professionals, medical directors, and industry executives who possess a comprehensive understanding of clinical workflows, operational bottlenecks, and institutional procurement structures.

The Consultant will provide strategic guidance on market expansion, evaluate institutional readiness, and lead high-level partnership initiatives. This role allows established practitioners and executives to maintain their primary clinical or corporate commitments while driving digital transformation and operational efficiency within the broader diagnostics sector.

Scope of Work & Objectives

  • Market Expansion & Alignment: Lead strategic expansion initiatives, identifying growth pathways and aligning Dashlabs.ai’s platform capabilities with the operational mandates of target institutions.

  • Institutional Engagement: Guide senior clinical, administrative, and financial stakeholders through the comprehensive evaluation of the platform, serving as a peer-level technical and operational advisor.

  • Partnership & Execution: Navigate complex institutional evaluation cycles, manage stakeholder alignment, and oversee the end-to-end engagement process from initial consultation to successful partnership execution.

  • Strategic Intelligence: Provide deep-dive assessments on market trends, regulatory shifts, and specific procurement workflows within the Philippine diagnostic ecosystem to optimize internal commercial strategies.

Consultant Profile & Qualifications

We are seeking independent partners with recognized domain expertise and structural authority within the Philippine diagnostic and healthcare sectors. This engagement is ideal for:

  • Pathologists & Medical Directors: Practicing or consulting physicians seeking to drive digital innovation and scalable healthtech adoption across clinical networks.

  • Laboratory & Imaging Executives: Current or former Chief Medical Technologists, Chief Radiologic Technologists, or diagnostic facility directors with a deep understanding of multi-center operational dynamics.

  • Healthcare Enterprise Specialists: Independent advisors or established representatives from the diagnostic hardware, IVD, or medical device sectors looking to complement capital equipment paradigms with operational software solutions.

  • Institutional Health Veterans: Professionals with a proven track record of managing operations, workflow integrations, or procurement within major hospital systems or diagnostic chains.

Key Competencies

  • Extensive knowledge of modern diagnostic workflows, laboratory information management, and healthcare facility infrastructure.

  • Proven capability to present complex technical and operational concepts authoritatively to C-level executives, medical boards, and purchasing committees.

  • Comprehensive understanding of the regulatory, financial, and administrative compliance standards governing healthcare institutions in the Philippines.

  • Professional fluency in English and Filipino.

This position is remote-first. Arrangement can be flexible (full-time or part-time, etc.).

Dashlabs.ai offers outstanding career opportunities, empowerment in the workplace, and a diverse, friendly team underpinned by competitive compensation packages. Offers for a paid position may be extended post-internship. Salary and level will be commensurate to the candidate's experience, qualifications, and applicable skillsets.

Dashlabs.ai (YC W21) is a healthcare operations platform that integrates Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Laboratory Information Systems (LIS), and Radiology Information Systems (RIS) into a unified ecosystem. Built for diagnostic laboratories, imaging centers, clinics, and hospitals, Dashlabs.ai serves as the operational backbone for diagnostic providers across the Philippines and is expanding its footprint into Indonesia and Malaysia. We build robust, scalable infrastructure to streamline healthcare workflows, optimize diagnostics, and improve patient outcomes.

raw.title: Product Marketing Manager
raw.excerpt: What You Can ExpectThis is a hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of product marketing, organic growth, and AI-native content creation.
raw.description:
What You Can Expect

This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of product marketing, organic growth, and AI-native content creation. You will shape how small and medium-sized businesses, solopreneurs, independent creators, and smaller teams discover and understand the Zoom AI Productivity Suite. You will personally take ideas from product insight through scripting, recording, editing, publishing, and measurement. This is an opportunity to build a content and distribution system from the ground up and see how your work contributes directly to product growth.

About the Team

The Zoom AI Productivity Suite team is building a new AI-native way to work, helping users move faster from conversation and ideation to polished, editable deliverables they can act on. As the product grows, this role will help more users understand its value and adopt it in their daily work. We are a product-led team looking for someone with sharp product judgment, hands-on content execution, and a genuine understanding of how people work and what earns their attention.

Responsibilities

  • Develop deep, working knowledge of the Zoom AI Productivity Suite, including who uses it, what problems it solves for small and medium-sized businesses and independent creators, how it compares to alternatives, and where its real advantages lie.
  • Define and maintain positioning and messaging that starts with the user problem, not the feature list, and translates product capabilities into clear, specific, outcome-oriented value.
  • Personally create and ship end-to-end product content, including short-form demos, screen recordings, tutorials, comparisons, social posts, emails, and web copy, from initial concept through publication and measurement, without depending on an agency or production team.
  • Use AI tools fluently across the full content workflow, including research, ideation, scripting, demo creation, editing, and rapid iteration, to move quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • Build a repeatable content and distribution engine from the ground up, making independent prioritization calls and driving execution without waiting for a fully developed brief or established process.
  • Plan and distribute platform-native content across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, X, Reddit, and LinkedIn, matching format and depth to the expectations of each audience and the stage of the funnel.
  • Identify and engage with third-party platforms, software-review sites, benchmark leaderboards, and vertical communities to build product credibility, drive discovery, and generate trial.
  • Track what is working using engagement quality, trial, subscription, and adoption signals, then use those findings to improve product stories, content formats, and calls to action.
  • Partner closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and marketing partners to keep product stories accurate and move content at the pace of product development.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, content marketing, growth marketing, social content, with a focus on digital products such as SaaS, AI tools, productivity platforms, or creator products, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong product instincts: the ability to identify the most important user problems, recognize genuine product differentiators, and turn those insights into product stories that are simple, specific, and credible, particularly for small and medium-sized business audiences, solopreneurs, independent creators, and smaller teams.
  • Hands-on fluency using AI tools for research, ideation, scripting, demo creation, video editing, and content iteration, not just familiarity with the tools but practical comfort shipping work with them.
  • Demonstrated ability to personally create and publish work end-to-end, including short-form product videos, screen-recorded demos, and social content created to market and explain digital products.
  • Strong understanding of how audiences, content formats, and distribution dynamics differ across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, X, Reddit, and LinkedIn, with demonstrated depth on at least some of these platforms.
  • A track record of building from scratch: cold-starting a content channel, a product launch, or a distribution system, and driving it forward through ambiguity without waiting for established processes. Candidates who have built and grown their own relevant content channels with measurable results are also encouraged to apply.
  • Experience at an AI-native, SaaS, productivity, or creator-product company is preferred, though not required if the work itself demonstrates the right instincts and execution ability.

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

Minimum:

$76,800.00

Maximum:

$186,200.00

In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.

We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

At Zoom, we offer a window of at least 5 days for you to apply because we believe in giving you every opportunity. Below is the potential closing date, just in case you want to mark it on your calendar. We look forward to receiving your application!

Anticipated Position Close Date:

09/11/26

Ways of Working
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.


Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learnfor more information.


About Us
Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

Our Commitment

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.

If you need assistance navigating the interview process due to a medical disability, please submit an Accommodations Request Form and someone from our team will reach out soon. This form is solely for applicants who require an accommodation due to a qualifying medical disability. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed.


Our interviews are supported by BrightHire, a tool that helps us create a consistent and thoughtful interview experience and may include recordings. Please refer to our candidate privacy statement for more information of how we use your data.

raw.description:
At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness.

Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

What You'll Do:

We're seeking a Revenue Enablement Manager - GTM Readiness & Adoption to support onboarding, enablement, readiness, and adoption initiatives across our global Go-to-Market (GTM)organization.

This role will partner with Revenue Operations, GTM Transformation, Product Marketing, Product Enablement, and business leaders to execute learning experiences, change readiness activities, onboarding programs, communications, and reinforcement plans that help employees successfully adopt new processes, tools, and ways of working.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, collaborative, data-driven, and passionate about helping teams learn, adapt, and perform at their best.

This role is 100% work from home role within the United States.

Responsibilities:

GTM Readiness & Adoption Planning

  • Build readiness, enablement, communication, and reinforcement plans that support adoption of strategic GTM initiatives.
  • Translate launch priorities into role-based learning journeys, manager tools, stakeholder communications, and adoption checkpoints.
  • Partner with GTM Transformation, RevOps, Product Enablement, Product Marketing, and Revenue Leadership to ensure teams are prepared for change.

AI-Enabled Workflow Adoption

  • Enable GTM teams to use AI-assisted workflows across reporting, pipeline inspection, day planning, prioritization, and customer-facing communication.
  • Partner with RevOps and GTM Transformation to embed AI guidance into existing tools, workflows, and enablement moments.
  • Define adoption and effectiveness measures that connect AI usage to productivity, ramp, workflow consistency, and enablement engagement.

Organizational Readiness & Adoption

  • Develop readiness assessments, stakeholder engagement plans, launch criteria, and adoption strategies for major GTM initiatives.
  • Identify adoption risks and organizational barriers, then proactively define mitigation plans.
  • Create role-based reinforcement plans that help employees and managers sustain new behaviors after launch.

Enablement and Learning Experiences

  • Design onboarding and enablement programs using modern learning modalities, including instructor-led, virtual, micro-learning, self-paced, cohort-based, and experiential learning.
  • Align onboarding to competency frameworks, role expectations, and time-to-productivity goals.
  • Use business priorities, learner feedback, and adoption data to continuously improve enablement experiences.

Sustainment & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish reinforcement strategies, leadership checkpoints, feedback loops, and inspection mechanisms that sustain adoption after launch.
  • Monitor initiative health and recommend improvements based on adoption data, stakeholder feedback, and evolving business needs.

What You Will Need to be Successful:

  • 3-5+ years of experience in revenue enablement, sales enablement, learning and development, onboarding, organizational development, change management, customer success enablement, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting onboarding, training, communication, or adoption initiatives.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience using learning technologies, digital learning tools, or AI-enabled productivity solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail and execution focus.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience supporting global or geographically distributed GTM organizations.
  • Background in organizational readiness, change management frameworks, or large-scale adoption initiatives.
  • Experience enabling adoption of AI, CRM, sales, customer success, or revenue technology workflows.
  • Strong partnership with GTM Transformation, Product Marketing, Product Enablement, Revenue Operations, or Business Operations teams.

Why First Advantage is Your Next Big Career Move:

First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best-in-class user experience, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact.
Additional benefits offered to our eligible people include:

  • Ability to work remotely with occasional business travel.

  • Medical, Vision, Dental, and supplementary benefit plans

  • 401k with an employer match, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

  • Competitive and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and 9 paid company holidays

  • Access to tech and growth opportunities, and leaders who want you to succeed!


What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today!
You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now!

The salary range for this position is approximately $90,000-100,00 annual base before bonus structure. This range reflects our good faith estimate to pay fairly as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate’s experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process.

We have great people here and are looking for more. Come join us!

Follow us:

  • Facebook

  • Instagram

  • LinkedIn

  • X

  • YouTube

Equal Employment Opportunities at First Advantage
First Advantage is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a workplace and recruitment process that is free from unlawful discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. Employment decisions at First Advantage are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate in any aspect of employment on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, religion, creed, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or family status, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

raw.title: Service Segment Director
raw.excerpt: OverviewWho we are—Transcat is a dynamic, innovative, growing company that has been recognized as the leading calibration and compliance services provider in North America and beyond.
raw.description:
Overview

Who we are—

Transcat is a dynamic, innovative, growing company that has been recognized as the leading calibration and compliance services provider in North America and beyond. With over 1,000 employees—in technical, consulting, operational, sales, finance, and corporate roles—we have stood the test of time by delivering on our Trust in Every Measure promise to our customers in vital industries, including life sciences, aerospace, defense, energy, and utilities. We fulfill this promise through our employees, who live Our Values every day, the Transcat Way. Our employees are at the center of the rewarding, challenging, and life-changing work we do for our customers and those they serve. Are you ready to join a company where the work you do makes a difference, and where you can grow in your career?

Here’s what Transcat has to offer—

  • Work that matters
  • A values-based culture where people care about each other and the work they do together
  • Flexibility
  • Training and development to accelerate learning and career advancement
  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including paid time off, health insurance, tuition reimbursement, retirement, stock purchase plan, and MORE!
  • Salary range is $150,000 - $200,000

The Service Segment Director is responsible for owning the commercial and strategic performance of defined calibration services categories. This role drives revenue growth, profitability, and market differentiation through strategy development, pricing leadership, service portfolio optimization, and cross-functional influence. The scope of this role requires strong collaboration and influence across Sales, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Quality, and Technology to deliver category outcomes. This role is remote with travel to our Rochester headquarters location required.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

1. Category Strategy and Market Leadership

  • Develop and execute a three–five year category strategy aligned with company growth objectives
  • Define target segments (e.g., biomedical, CBLs, data/AI, flow, GSE, and pipettes) and customer value propositions
  • Analyze market trends, regulatory requirements, and competitor positioning
  • Identify and prioritize growth and margin growth opportunities (e.g., new services, geographic expansion)
  • Lead service differentiation initiatives (e.g., turnaround time, compliance assurance, value-added analytics)

2. P&L Influence & Strategy

  • Strategically optimize category performance and profitability by steering revenue mix, gross margin expansion, and cost-to-serve improvements.
  • Design and implement pricing strategies, including discounting guardrails and contract structures to maximize deal profitability.
  • Champion pricing discipline across sales teams to ensure alignment with organizational margin targets.

3. Service Portfolio Management

  • Define and continuously optimize the calibration and solutions service portfolio
  • Rationalize low-margin or low-demand offerings
  • Develop bundled service offerings and subscription models
  • Introduce new services based on customer needs, industry standards, or technology advancements
  • Ensure alignment with operational capabilities and quality requirements

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Influence

  • Partner with Sales to enable growth and margin improvement across the service portfolio through training, tools, process discipline, and value messaging
  • Work with Operations/Labs to align capacity, turnaround times, and cost structures
  • Collaborate with Quality/Compliance to ensure adherence to accreditation and regulatory standards
  • Engage Marketing to develop targeted campaigns and thought leadership
  • Coordinate with Distribution and Rentals for equipment, standards, and vendor optimization
  • Partner with IT to ensure technology infrastructure and software assets strategically support overarching business objectives.
  • Influence senior stakeholders to drive alignment on priorities, investments, and trade-offs

5. Customer and Commercial Excellence

  • Act as the voice of the customer
  • Support key account strategy and large/strategic deal structuring
  • Develop standardized proposals, pricing frameworks, and service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Drive customer retention and expansion through improved service value

Qualifications

Essential Skills and Competencies

Strategic and Commercial

  • Category strategy development
  • Pricing strategy and value-based selling
  • Market and competitive analysis

Leadership

  • Strong influencing and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to drive alignment across diverse teams without direct reporting lines
  • Adept at translating complex strategies into clear, persuasive visual and verbal narratives for top-tier stakeholders

Analytical

  • Data-driven decision making
  • Financial modeling and business case development

Operational Understanding

  • Knowledge of service delivery models and cost structures in technical service environments

Strategic Attributes

  • Adaptable and resilient: Thrives in complex, matrixed environments
  • Analytical and decisive: Uses data to make informed, timely decisions
  • Commercially driven: Relentless focus on growth and profitability
  • Continuous improvement mindset: Seeks efficiency, innovation, and differentiation
  • Customer-centric: Deep understanding of customer needs and value drivers
  • Enterprise thinker: Balances category optimization with broader company objectives
  • Highly collaborative: Builds trust and alignment across functions
  • Influential leader: Drives outcomes with and without formal authority

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business or a related field
  • 5+ years of successful experience in service industry

Bonus Experience

  • Experience in a related industry (e.g., test equipment, distribution, calibration)
  • Experience with strategic sourcing
  • Leadership experience

Equal Opportunity and Non-Discrimination

Transcat is an equal-opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination based on any protected status. As required by United States law, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, disability, genetic predisposition or carrier status, national origin, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), status as a protected veteran, or as a member of any other protected group or activity under federal, state, and local law.

We will make reasonable accommodations for employees with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their position unless doing so poses an undue hardship to the company or a direct threat to health or safety.

Contingencies

All offers of employment are contingent upon successfully completing all pre-employment requirements, which include verification of identity and employment eligibility, and when applicable, a motor vehicle driving record report.

raw.title: Product Manager, Stablecoin & Digital Assets
raw.excerpt: Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform.
raw.description:
Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.
Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).

You'll own Jeeves' stablecoin and digital asset strategy—defining how blockchain rails transform cross-border payments, treasury management, and settlement for global businesses. This role requires someone who is crypto-obsessed and deeply familiar with the stablecoin ecosystem: issuance and reserve models, on/off-ramp mechanics, fiat rail interoperability, and institutional adoption trends. We want someone who has built stablecoin or crypto payment products at a stablecoin issuer, crypto exchange, cross-border payment platform, or fintech building on blockchain rails.

Location: This role is based out of Argentina, and is a full-time remote position.

What You'll Do

    Stablecoin Product Strategy

    • Own the stablecoin product roadmap: which rails to build on, which stablecoins to support, and how they integrate into payments and treasury workflows

    • Build institutional-grade infrastructure that abstracts blockchain complexity while preserving speed and cost advantages for end users

    • Drive the full product lifecycle from ideation through launch, collaborating with engineering, design, legal, compliance, and commercial teams

      • Cross-Border Payments & Treasury

      • Build products that let businesses send, receive, convert, and hold stablecoins alongside fiat across USD, EUR, BRL, MXN, and local currency corridors

      • Design seamless on/off-ramp flows that feel as simple as traditional banking, even for users who have never touched crypto

      • Ensure interoperability with fiat rails (ACH, Fedwire, SWIFT, SEPA, PIX, SPEI) so stablecoins become a natural extension of existing payment infrastructure

        • Compliance, Risk & Custody

        • Navigate US state licensing, MiCA, and LatAm crypto regulations to ship compliant products in every market we serve

        • Embed AML/KYC, Travel Rule, and transaction monitoring requirements into the product from day one

        • Evaluate wallet infrastructure, custodians, and key management solutions that meet institutional-grade security standards

          • Partnerships & Go-to-Market

          • Evaluate and manage partnerships with stablecoin issuers, liquidity providers, custodians, and banking partners

          • Enable Sales and Customer Success to position stablecoin products and close deals with CFOs and treasury teams

          • Ship, measure, and iterate—track adoption metrics and ruthlessly prioritize based on data and business impact

What We're Looking For:

    Required

    • 4+ years in product management at a stablecoin infrastructure provider, crypto exchange, cross-border payments company, or fintech building on blockchain rails

    • Deep stablecoin expertise: issuance and redemption mechanics, reserve models, on-chain settlement, ecosystem dynamics, and how stablecoins interact with treasury flows and FX

    • Strong understanding of fiat rails: ACH, wires, RTP, SWIFT, SEPA, PIX, SPEI—and how reconciliation, settlement timing, and fiat conversions work alongside stablecoin flows

    • Blockchain infrastructure literacy: EVM chains, Solana, Layer 2s, wallet architecture, key management, and custody. Able to converse with engineers on API docs and system design

    • Regulatory fluency: AML/KYC frameworks, Travel Rule, MiCA, US state-by-state licensing, and how compliance requirements vary by jurisdiction

    • Analytical rigor: comfortable with SQL, dashboards, and building data-driven business cases

    • Exceptional communication: can write strategy memos and product specs that align cross-functional stakeholders

      • Strongly Preferred

      • Track record of owning complex, regulated financial products from concept through production at scale

      • Relationships in the stablecoin ecosystem—issuers, custodians, liquidity providers, or regulators

      • Experience with multi-market products serving LatAm, US, and/or European customers

      • Familiarity with developer platforms, API design, and ecosystem-driven products

      • Background in traditional payments or banking

Why This Role Matters:

    Cross-border payments move $150+ trillion annually through slow, expensive, opaque systems. Stablecoins are the most promising technology to fix this—but most stablecoin products today are built for crypto-native users, not the finance teams at global businesses who move billions daily. At Jeeves, you'll bridge that gap and shape how thousands of global businesses adopt stablecoin-powered finance.

raw.description:
Engagement Overview

Dashlabs.ai is retaining fractional Growth and Industry Consultants to advise on and accelerate platform adoption across the Philippine healthcare ecosystem. This independent consultancy role is designed for senior healthcare professionals, medical directors, and industry executives who possess a comprehensive understanding of clinical workflows, operational bottlenecks, and institutional procurement structures.

The Consultant will provide strategic guidance on market expansion, evaluate institutional readiness, and lead high-level partnership initiatives. This role allows established practitioners and executives to maintain their primary clinical or corporate commitments while driving digital transformation and operational efficiency within the broader diagnostics sector.

Scope of Work & Objectives

  • Market Expansion & Alignment: Lead strategic expansion initiatives, identifying growth pathways and aligning Dashlabs.ai’s platform capabilities with the operational mandates of target institutions.

  • Institutional Engagement: Guide senior clinical, administrative, and financial stakeholders through the comprehensive evaluation of the platform, serving as a peer-level technical and operational advisor.

  • Partnership & Execution: Navigate complex institutional evaluation cycles, manage stakeholder alignment, and oversee the end-to-end engagement process from initial consultation to successful partnership execution.

  • Strategic Intelligence: Provide deep-dive assessments on market trends, regulatory shifts, and specific procurement workflows within the Philippine diagnostic ecosystem to optimize internal commercial strategies.

Consultant Profile & Qualifications

We are seeking independent partners with recognized domain expertise and structural authority within the Philippine diagnostic and healthcare sectors. This engagement is ideal for:

  • Pathologists & Medical Directors: Practicing or consulting physicians seeking to drive digital innovation and scalable healthtech adoption across clinical networks.

  • Laboratory & Imaging Executives: Current or former Chief Medical Technologists, Chief Radiologic Technologists, or diagnostic facility directors with a deep understanding of multi-center operational dynamics.

  • Healthcare Enterprise Specialists: Independent advisors or established representatives from the diagnostic hardware, IVD, or medical device sectors looking to complement capital equipment paradigms with operational software solutions.

  • Institutional Health Veterans: Professionals with a proven track record of managing operations, workflow integrations, or procurement within major hospital systems or diagnostic chains.

Key Competencies

  • Extensive knowledge of modern diagnostic workflows, laboratory information management, and healthcare facility infrastructure.

  • Proven capability to present complex technical and operational concepts authoritatively to C-level executives, medical boards, and purchasing committees.

  • Comprehensive understanding of the regulatory, financial, and administrative compliance standards governing healthcare institutions in the Philippines.

  • Professional fluency in English and Filipino.

This position is remote-first. Arrangement can be flexible (full-time or part-time, etc.).

Dashlabs.ai offers outstanding career opportunities, empowerment in the workplace, and a diverse, friendly team underpinned by competitive compensation packages. Offers for a paid position may be extended post-internship. Salary and level will be commensurate to the candidate's experience, qualifications, and applicable skillsets.

Dashlabs.ai (YC W21) is a healthcare operations platform that integrates Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Laboratory Information Systems (LIS), and Radiology Information Systems (RIS) into a unified ecosystem. Built for diagnostic laboratories, imaging centers, clinics, and hospitals, Dashlabs.ai serves as the operational backbone for diagnostic providers across the Philippines and is expanding its footprint into Indonesia and Malaysia. We build robust, scalable infrastructure to streamline healthcare workflows, optimize diagnostics, and improve patient outcomes.

At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Job Summary
Designs, analyzes, modifies, and integrates robotics, automation, technologies and processes related to equipment and tooling for applicability to programs and products. Develops, implements, and tests preventative maintenance plans, interim solutions for damaged and unsafe equipment, and tooling. Investigates and documents engineering changes and controls equipment and tooling configuration in accordance with standard operating procedures. Develops and recommends equipment reliability improvements through the application of reliability engineering tooling.

Education & Experience
Typically requires 4 -8 years of experience
Typically College or university degree required

Responsibilities
Lead project delivery across design, analysis, integration, and validation of automation systems; define architectures, specifications, and acceptance criteria; guide test planning, data collection, and performance verification; drive reliability engineering and maintainability improvements; manage change control, documentation, and configuration integrity; coordinate cross-functional interfaces and readiness for deployment; embed safety, quality, and compliance in solutions; mentor contributors and promote standardized practices to ensure operational excellence.

Skills/ Ability Generic (High Level)
Exhibit advanced proficiency in automation principles, robotics, and system integration; plan and manage scope, schedule, and risk effectively; communicate requirements and decisions with clarity; analyze complex datasets and test evidence for informed decision-making; apply reliability, maintainability, and validation methodologies; lead continuous improvement and standardization initiatives; foster collaboration across technical and operational teams.

Опис посади

  • Здійснює проєктування, аналіз, модифікацію та інтеграцію рішень у сфері робототехніки, автоматизації, технологій і процесів, пов’язаних з обладнанням та технологічним оснащенням, для їх застосування у програмах і продуктах компанії.

  • Розробляє, впроваджує та тестує плани превентивного технічного обслуговування, а також тимчасові рішення для пошкодженого або небезпечного обладнання й оснащення.

  • Проводить аналіз і документування інженерних змін, забезпечує контроль конфігурації обладнання та оснащення відповідно до затверджених стандартних операційних процедур.

  • Ініціює та рекомендує заходи з підвищення надійності обладнання шляхом застосування інструментів і методологій reliability engineering.

Освіта та досвід

  • Як правило, вимагається 4–8 років релевантного професійного досвіду

  • Повна вища освіта (ступінь бакалавра або магістра) є обов’язковою

Основні обов’язки

  • Забезпечує управління реалізацією проєктів у напрямках проєктування, аналізу, інтеграції та валідації систем автоматизації; визначає архітектуру рішень, технічні специфікації та критерії приймання.

  • Координує процеси планування випробувань, збору даних і підтвердження експлуатаційних характеристик.

  • Ініціює та впроваджує заходи з підвищення надійності й ремонтопридатності обладнання.

  • Забезпечує управління змінами, ведення технічної документації та підтримання цілісності конфігурації.

  • Координує взаємодію між функціональними командами та забезпечує готовність рішень до впровадження.

  • Інтегрує вимоги безпеки, якості та відповідності нормативним стандартам у процес розробки рішень.

  • Сприяє розвитку команди шляхом наставництва та впровадження стандартизованих практик для досягнення операційної ефективності.

Ключові навички та компетенції

  • Високий рівень експертизи у сфері автоматизації, робототехніки та системної інтеграції

  • Здатність ефективно управляти обсягом робіт, термінами реалізації та ризиками

  • Розвинені навички комунікації та структурованого формулювання вимог і рішень

  • Досвід аналізу складних масивів даних і результатів тестувань для прийняття обґрунтованих рішень

  • Практичне застосування методологій reliability, maintainability та validation engineering

  • Досвід впровадження ініціатив безперервного вдосконалення та стандартизації процесів

  • Здатність забезпечувати ефективну взаємодію між технічними та операційними командами

  • Володіння Англійською мовою на рівні від В1+ та вижче

raw.description:
What You Can Expect

This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of product marketing, organic growth, and AI-native content creation. You will shape how small and medium-sized businesses, solopreneurs, independent creators, and smaller teams discover and understand the Zoom AI Productivity Suite. You will personally take ideas from product insight through scripting, recording, editing, publishing, and measurement. This is an opportunity to build a content and distribution system from the ground up and see how your work contributes directly to product growth.

About the Team

The Zoom AI Productivity Suite team is building a new AI-native way to work, helping users move faster from conversation and ideation to polished, editable deliverables they can act on. As the product grows, this role will help more users understand its value and adopt it in their daily work. We are a product-led team looking for someone with sharp product judgment, hands-on content execution, and a genuine understanding of how people work and what earns their attention.

Responsibilities

  • Develop deep, working knowledge of the Zoom AI Productivity Suite, including who uses it, what problems it solves for small and medium-sized businesses and independent creators, how it compares to alternatives, and where its real advantages lie.
  • Define and maintain positioning and messaging that starts with the user problem, not the feature list, and translates product capabilities into clear, specific, outcome-oriented value.
  • Personally create and ship end-to-end product content, including short-form demos, screen recordings, tutorials, comparisons, social posts, emails, and web copy, from initial concept through publication and measurement, without depending on an agency or production team.
  • Use AI tools fluently across the full content workflow, including research, ideation, scripting, demo creation, editing, and rapid iteration, to move quickly without sacrificing quality.
  • Build a repeatable content and distribution engine from the ground up, making independent prioritization calls and driving execution without waiting for a fully developed brief or established process.
  • Plan and distribute platform-native content across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, X, Reddit, and LinkedIn, matching format and depth to the expectations of each audience and the stage of the funnel.
  • Identify and engage with third-party platforms, software-review sites, benchmark leaderboards, and vertical communities to build product credibility, drive discovery, and generate trial.
  • Track what is working using engagement quality, trial, subscription, and adoption signals, then use those findings to improve product stories, content formats, and calls to action.
  • Partner closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and marketing partners to keep product stories accurate and move content at the pace of product development.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, content marketing, growth marketing, social content, with a focus on digital products such as SaaS, AI tools, productivity platforms, or creator products, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong product instincts: the ability to identify the most important user problems, recognize genuine product differentiators, and turn those insights into product stories that are simple, specific, and credible, particularly for small and medium-sized business audiences, solopreneurs, independent creators, and smaller teams.
  • Hands-on fluency using AI tools for research, ideation, scripting, demo creation, video editing, and content iteration, not just familiarity with the tools but practical comfort shipping work with them.
  • Demonstrated ability to personally create and publish work end-to-end, including short-form product videos, screen-recorded demos, and social content created to market and explain digital products.
  • Strong understanding of how audiences, content formats, and distribution dynamics differ across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube, X, Reddit, and LinkedIn, with demonstrated depth on at least some of these platforms.
  • A track record of building from scratch: cold-starting a content channel, a product launch, or a distribution system, and driving it forward through ambiguity without waiting for established processes. Candidates who have built and grown their own relevant content channels with measurable results are also encouraged to apply.
  • Experience at an AI-native, SaaS, productivity, or creator-product company is preferred, though not required if the work itself demonstrates the right instincts and execution ability.

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

Minimum:

$76,800.00

Maximum:

$186,200.00

In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.

We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

At Zoom, we offer a window of at least 5 days for you to apply because we believe in giving you every opportunity. Below is the potential closing date, just in case you want to mark it on your calendar. We look forward to receiving your application!

Anticipated Position Close Date:

09/11/26

Ways of Working
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.


Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learnfor more information.


About Us
Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

Our Commitment

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.

If you need assistance navigating the interview process due to a medical disability, please submit an Accommodations Request Form and someone from our team will reach out soon. This form is solely for applicants who require an accommodation due to a qualifying medical disability. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed.


Our interviews are supported by BrightHire, a tool that helps us create a consistent and thoughtful interview experience and may include recordings. Please refer to our candidate privacy statement for more information of how we use your data.

Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What Clinical Operations does at Worldwide

At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we invite you to embark on a rewarding journey within Clinical Operations, where your contributions will leave a profound impact on the lives of patients.

As a Clinical Research Associate (CRA) at Worldwide, you will find yourself working alongside brilliant minds across diverse therapeutic areas, including Cardiovascular, Metabolic, Neuroscience, Oncology, and Rare Diseases. Collaboration with top-tier colleagues from various backgrounds and specialties is not just encouraged; it's ingrained in our culture. Our commitment to advancing clinical research is nurtured within a supportive and team-oriented environment. In a CRA role, you'll receive extensive support through regulatory submissions, TMF management, and in-house CRAs for projects with heavy site management needs.

Through regular touchpoints and coaching conversations with your Line Manager, we ensure that your professional development remains a top priority. We offer a clear career path and development that can lead to Clinical Trial Manager roles. We take pride in our accessible Executive Leadership team, who are equally committed to advancing science and surmounting obstacles to make a difference in the lives of patients around the world.

We offer an unparalleled experience, where you can drive remarkable scientific breakthroughs and be at the very core of every successful clinical trial. Experience a world of difference with us at Worldwide!

What you will do

  • Responsible for managing the research activities at sites participating in Worldwide’s clinical research projects

  • Typically involved in all stages of the clinical study, including identifying potential sites to participate in the research effort, performing various study start-up activities such as working with sites to collect appropriate regulatory documents and supporting the negotiation of contracts and budgets, training the sites to collect data properly and report any potential safety-related events, managing the site's activities during study maintenance, and closing down research activities at the sites once the study has concluded

  • Conduct study initiation visits (SIVs)

  • While most of the site management efforts will be performed remotely, you will be required to ensure compliance with obtaining informed consent, reporting potential safety-related events, and adhering to all applicable regulatory requirements

What you will bring to the role

  • Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills in English

  • Superior organizational skills with attention to detail

  • Ability to work with little or no supervision

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, CTMS, and EDC Systems

Your experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate

  • 4-year university degree OR Nursing Degree

  • Experience in CNS/Neurology and Rare Disease are required

  • Candidates must reside in the Midwest

  • Willingness to travel regionally required

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit or connect with us on LinkedIn.

raw.excerpt: Location: Bay Area Our Team: ​​Semtech's commercial (sales) team is a high-performing, strategic group driving Semtech's transformation into an industry-leading demand generation organization.
raw.description:
Location: Bay Area

Our Team:

​​Semtech's commercial (sales) team is a high-performing, strategic group driving Semtech's transformation into an industry-leading demand generation organization. We recognize that our rep partners are strategic extensions of our go-to-market engine and critical force multipliers for reaching customers we can't serve directly. We thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where tenacity, grit, and collaboration define our culture, measuring success by the trust we build with customers and partners, the innovative solutions we deliver together, and the market share we capture through disciplined execution.

​​

Job Summary:

​​The Strategic Account Manager is quota-carrying regional sales position that will serve as a market share warrior, trusted customer advisor, and strategic partner orchestrator—driving explosive revenue growth through world-class demand generation across direct accounts and rep-covered territories. This high-impact position combines strategic vision with competitive sales instincts, orchestrating complex deals while building best-in-class rep firm relationships that multiply market reach. You'll be part business strategist, part performance coach, part trusted advisor, and part market intelligence officer—leveraging deep customer intimacy and systematic rep enablement to outmaneuver competition.

​

​Your dual mandate spans the full Semtech portfolio: secure design wins with direct strategic accounts while building rep firm capability, alignment, and performance that amplifies your impact across territories. Success requires becoming a trusted advisor whom customers welcome into confidential discussions while creating strategic partnerships where rep firm success directly fuels Semtech's growth. You'llleverage consultative discovery to uncover business consequences and decision criteria driving customer choices, while coaching reps to do the same. Success will be measured by market share gains, customer and partner loyalty, design-win velocity, and pipeline conversion at industry-leading rates. Time allocation between direct accounts and rep firms flexes based on territory revenue mix and growth potential, requiring strategic prioritization and dynamic resource optimization.

​​

Responsibilities:​

​Strategic Account Management, Revenue Growth & Design-Win Pursuit

  • ​Develop and execute comprehensive account plans for assigned customer accounts using consultative discovery methodologies

  • ​Build strategic customer relationships to identify opportunities for Semtech solutions across multiple product lines

  • ​Drive annual revenue achievement through strategic account development, design-win pursuit, and production ramp management

  • ​Partner with FAEs to drive technical evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and design-in activities for direct accounts

  • ​Translate customer technical requirements into compelling business cases and commercial proposals

  • ​Track design-win funnel from engagement through qualification and production ramp

  • ​Build and maintain qualified pipeline of 3-4x quota coverage with systematic opportunity progression

  • ​Lead pricing negotiations, MSA/NDA execution, and commercial terms protecting margins

  • ​Cultivate executive relationships with procurement, supply chain, and engineering management

  • ​Coordinate customer technical and commercial issue resolution across internal resources

​Rep Firm Management, Revenue Growth & Development

  • ​Manage 1-3 rep firms across assigned territory with accountability for revenue growth, performance metrics including NBOs, design-wins, CRM compliance, and revenue attainment

  • ​Conduct quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with rep principals assessing performance scorecards, territory coverage, and strategic alignment

  • ​Partner with rep firms and FAEs to drive technical evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and design-in activities across rep-covered accounts

  • ​Track rep-driven design-win funnel progression and production ramp execution

  • ​Develop rep capability through product training, technical solution selling coaching, and market intelligence sharing

  • ​Monitor rep/distributor/direct commission conflicts and resolve using proof-of-influence methodology

  • ​Build territory coverage strategies optimizing rep allocation and identifying underperforming coverage areas

  • ​Track rep firm metrics including trip reports, opportunity quality, forecast accuracy, and customer engagement effectiveness

  • ​Initiate performance improvement plans when rep firms fall below standards, making recommendations for rep changes when necessary

  • ​Negotiate territory assignments, commission structures, and resource allocation based on ROI justification

​Business Operations & Forecasting

  • ​Deliver accurate monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts with appropriate lead-time visibility incorporating rep firm inputs

  • ​Maintain Salesforce accuracy ensuring pipeline hygiene and data quality across direct and rep-managed opportunities

  • ​Prepare and present Opportunity Reviews, Account Plans, Pipeline Reviews, and Rep QBRs to leadership

  • ​Track and report KPIs including design-win count, revenue attainment, win/loss ratios, rep performance metrics, and customer satisfaction

  • ​Develop account-specific and territory-wide pricing strategies balancing competitiveness with profitability

  • ​Maintain working knowledge of Semtech product portfolio and competitive alternatives

​Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • ​Provide customer and rep firm feedback plus competitive intelligence to product marketing and leadership

  • ​Coordinate with supply chain and operations teams on demand planning, allocation, and new product introductions

  • ​Establish collaborative relationships with Semtech account managers supporting ecosystem players

  • ​Identify and engage technical influencers, consultants, and partners impacting customer technology selection

  • ​Support marketing initiatives including customer success stories, trade shows, and technical content

​​

Minimum Qualifications:

  • ​​5+ years in a customer-facing technical role within the semiconductor or data center interconnect industry — Field Applications Engineer, Applications Engineer, Sales Applications Engineer, Product Line Manager, or Product Marketing Engineer all qualify. Direct quota-carrying sales experience is preferred but not required.

  • ​Working technical fluency in at least one of the following: signal integrity products (retimers, redrivers, TIAs, laser drivers), optical interconnect, or adjacent high-speed data center silicon. You should be comfortable holding a technical conversation with a customer's engineering team about the products you've supported.

  • ​A track record of taking initiative — engaging customers directly, driving outcomes across functional boundaries, and moving deals or projects forward without waiting to be asked.

  • ​Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into customer and business terms.

  • ​Comfort operating in ambiguity. This is a greenfield territory — you'll help shape the pipeline, the relationships, and how we go to market.

  • ​Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent industry experience.

​​

Desired Qualifications

  • ​​Existing relationships at Microsoft, AWS, Meta, or Apple in the Pacific Northwest, particularly within data center, silicon photonics, or hardware engineering organizations.

  • ​Direct experience with signal integrity or optical products selling into hyperscaler or large OEM accounts.

  • ​Exposure to the commercial side of the business — pricing discussions, customer negotiations, design-win pursuit, or pipeline management — even if not in a formal sales seat.

  • ​Experience working with rep firms, distributors, or channel partners.

  • ​Familiarity with Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

  • ​Advanced technical degree, MSEE or MBA.

​​

The intent of this job description is to describe the major duties and responsibilities performed by incumbents of this job. Incumbents may be required to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically included in this description.

All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions and requirements and are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.

The Solutions Engineeris responsible for assessing, developing and supporting the implementation of logistics solutions that improve current and prospective clients’ business models. The individual will possess strong evaluation skills as you review current state, using appropriate tools/diagrams. Detailed data analysis will complement the process to ensure an ideal future state is designed. As an integral part of the Transportation Insight sales process, the Solutions Engineer will be a hands-on leader.

This role is responsible for supporting the deal cycle with an emphasis on strategic thought, business acumen, creative problem-solving, flexibility, and sound judgment. The Solutions Engineer will collaborate with key cross-functional stakeholders, senior-level team members and prospective clients to design a solution that meets client-stated needs/requirements, can be operated by the organization, and that is profitable.

The individual in this role brings demonstrated skills in consultative selling, supply chain management, TMS system implementation, project management and is able to apply these skills effectively across functional departments.  They are able to price complex multi-mode service solutions and provide key inputs for the production, demonstration and presentation of documents to prospective clients. 

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Why should you join our team?

American AgCredit offers a unique opportunity to be a part of a national financial system supporting those who feed, clothe and fuel the world. We are a growing organization embracing collaboration and innovation while delivering transformative solutions. American AgCredit provides a cultivating environment where you truly make a difference for our customers and teams.

Benefits offered by American AgCredit:

  • Commitment to agriculture and the communities we serve
  • Family friendly work environment
  • Investment in employee development
  • Medical, Dental and Vision coverage
  • Outstanding 401k – automatic 3% employer contribution, plus match up to 6%
  • Generous Paid Time Off (Vacation accrued at 21 days annually, Sick Days accrued at 15 days annually, 12 paid holidays, plus 16 hours of volunteer time)
  • Competitive Incentive Compensation Plan
  • Disability & Life Insurance
  • Employee mental, physical, and financial wellness programs
  • The position is bonus eligible based on association and personal performance

Position will be posted until filled.

BASIC FUNCTION:

The Association's Internal Controls Policy establishes the goal of supporting an enterprise-wide Regulatory Compliance Program through monitoring, education, and training. The Compliance Quality Assurance Analyst plays a critical role in supporting the Compliance Program by assisting in the design, implementation, and ongoing management of the organization’s quality assurance and regulatory management programs. This position is responsible for monitoring regulatory changes, assisting with regulatory examination activity, conducting compliance risk assessments, collaborating with subject matter experts, and ensuring the organization adheres to all relevant laws and standards. The Compliance Quality Assurance Analyst will help maintain robust compliance methodologies and contribute to continuous improvement in compliance risk management processes.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

  • Collaborate with compliance leaders to design, implement, and manage quality assurance programs that ensure compliance across all business units.

  • Track evolving regulatory requirements, analyze their impact, and support organizational adherence to applicable laws and standards.

  • Assist with the coordination of audit and regulatory examination activities, including tracking requests, gathering supporting documentation, and facilitating communication with internal stakeholders and examiners.

  • Assist in directing and conducting comprehensive compliance risk assessments, including identifying industry-specific risk areas and evaluating historical compliance issues.

  • Work with compliance team leaders to develop and maintain risk assessment methodologies, including metrics, definitions, and documentation procedures.

  • Identify and engage subject matter experts (SMEs) and risk owners to facilitate effective compliance assessment processes.

  • Collect, analyze, and tabulate assessment results; create risk matrices; and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.

  • Solicit feedback from stakeholders and incorporate suggestions to refine compliance risk management processes.

  • Draft and maintain quality assurance (i.e., testing) plans for each risk area, specifying objectives, sample selection, assessment policies, criteria, and schedules.

  • Assign responsibilities, monitor progress, and report on the status of quality assurance initiatives.

  • Perform independent testing on material rules, laws, and regulations to ensure compliance.

  • Assist in the development and implementation of corrective action plans to address identified compliance deficiencies.

  • Perform design and operating effectiveness validation work in accordance with the issue management processes.

  • Prepare reports for management detailing compliance quality assurance activities, findings, and recommended improvements.

  • Support the Association's regulatory management program, which includes efforts focused on regulatory change, remediation, and examinations.

  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Director of Regulatory Management

LEVELS OF SUPERVISION EXERCISED AND RECEIVED

Exercises no supervision; works under the general direction and supervision of the Director of Regulatory Management.


TYPICAL KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 5 years of directly related experience in the diversified financial services industry (preferred), including regulatory, legal, audit, lending, and operations experience.
  • Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science degree or equivalent.
  • Ability to prioritize work to meet deadlines in a collaborative setting and independently.
  • Experience leading, supporting, or coordinating audit and/or regulatory examination activities, including serving as a liaison with internal and external auditors and examiners.
  • Knowledge of Enterprise Risk Management frameworks, risk management processes, risk appetite statements, key risk measures/indicators (leading vs. lagging), risk assessment, and review.
  • Thorough knowledge of the correct use of the English language, excellent proofreading, editing, formatting, and spelling skills.
  • Proficient in using software and information technology to collect, organize, maintain, and disseminate information. Ability to utilize and leverage technology in new or complex situations.
  • Strong written and oral communication and facilitation skills as well as analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder interaction skills.
  • Ability to problem solve and execute work quickly, accurately, and thoughtfully.
  • Professional presence, positive demeanor, and ability to interact effectively with all levels of employees, management, external auditors, and regulatory agencies.
  • Possess a forward-thinking, enterprise mindset to stay ahead of potential, emerging risks.
  • High integrity and discretion, sound judgment, and strong work ethic.
  • Ability to travel domestically up to 10% annually.

ESSENTIAL JOB REQUIREMENTS:

The employee will be sitting for extended periods and accomplishing work at a desk and a computer for an extended period. Must have strong written and verbal communication skills to convey ideas and work with a team effectively. The ability to talk and hear, sit and use their hands and fingers, and reach in all directions is essential in the performance of the job. Some lifting and moving of items up to 25 pounds is required. Work during established business hours and may require occasional weekend and evening work. Travel required.

raw.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.


Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.


Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.


As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.


We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.


About the Role

The Grading Operations software engineering team builds and operates the internal software that runs our grading and authentication business. That means the applications our operations teams work in every day, the services and APIs behind them, the scheduled and event-driven processes that move items through the grading lifecycle, and the integrations that connect all of it to adjacent systems across the platform.

Volume climbs every year and the systems have kept up. As our grading operations reach more markets, keeping pace means solving for distance as well as volume.

This is a role for an engineer who wants projects that do not have an obvious solution yet. You will own complex, loosely defined projects, take the lead when they span other engineering teams, and help raise the design bar across the team. The breadth is unusual for one role: a containerized core application, serverless services, event-driven pipelines, and the applications our operations teams work in all day. You will still be building and shipping what you design, and AI tooling is central to how we work rather than something we are trying out.

What You'll Do

  • Take on complex, loosely defined projects, including those that span other engineering teams, and own their design from first sketch to production

  • Build backend services, APIs, and data models that power the internal applications our grading and authentication teams rely on every day

  • Work across a mix of architectures, from a large containerized .NET application to smaller serverless APIs and Python background processing jobs, and help decide which is the right fit for new work

  • Design and implement event-driven and asynchronous systems that keep operational data flowing reliably at high volume

  • Mentor other engineers on the team through design review, code review, and the way you work through hard problems

  • Contribute to frontend application development using JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue.js to deliver features end to end

  • Collaborate with Product, Tech, and Operations teams to translate business requirements into clean technical designs across both backend and frontend systems

  • Troubleshoot data, integration, service, and UI issues across a large, long-lived codebase

  • Share in an on-call rotation supporting the services the team owns

  • Write design documents and technical decision records that other engineers build against

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience building production applications, with deep experience in backend systems and some hands-on experience delivering frontend work

  • 5+ years experience / strong proficiency in C# and .NET

  • Routine use of AI tooling as part of how you design and build software, with the judgment to review and take responsibility for what it produces

  • A track record of delivering projects where the requirements were unclear at the start and the right design was not obvious

  • A history of mentoring strong engineers and visibly improving how a team designs and builds

  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and service integrations

  • Sound judgment about where code belongs, including how to draw module boundaries inside a large application and when a capability warrants its own service, and the ability to explain the calls you got wrong as clearly as the ones you got right

  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for services running in production

  • Strong fundamentals working with relational databases and data modeling (e.g. SQL Server, PostgreSQL)

  • Hands-on experience building and operating production services in the cloud, including container orchestration (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, ECS), serverless compute behind an API gateway, and managed messaging and data stores

  • Comfortable working in a modern frontend codebase, with hands-on experience in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and a component-based framework

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation), and monitoring and observability tooling (e.g. CloudWatch, Datadog)

  • Design documents clear enough that the decision is obvious by the end of them

  • Experience turning complex requirements from Product and Operations partners into clean, extensible systems

  • Familiar with Agile/Scrum methodologies

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing asynchronous, event-driven, and distributed systems, including systems that operate across regions

  • Experience with any of AWS, Python (including test frameworks such as pytest or unittest), Apache Kafka, DynamoDB, or Vue.js

  • Experience partnering closely with Product, and comfort working directly with the operations and business teams who use what you build

  • Experience making high-volume workflows faster, in the interface or behind it, where shaving seconds off a repeated task adds up across thousands of items


Collectors uses e-Verify to validate your ability to work legally in the United States.


We are aware that there are instances where individuals are receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from Collectors or one of our business units. This type of fraud can be carried out through false websites, through fake e-mails claiming to be from the company or through social media. We never ask for personal information such as your bank account, Social Security numbers or National IDs, nor do we send or request payments for the purchase of business-related equipment.
